description:
Company: Healthy Energetics LLC

Location: Remote / Work from Home

Job Type: Contract (1099 Independent Contractor)

Salary: 8% – 20% Commission per sale

Description: Are you a practicing holistic specialist or a gifted individual with a passion for traditional wellness? Healthy Energetics is looking for independent, self-motivated Affiliate Partners to join our wellness mission. In this role, you will work autonomously to educate clients on our specialized product lines, including our unique Yogurt Culture systems and traditional wellness supplements.

We provide the informational guides and product knowledge—you provide the expertise and the passion to help others transform their health.



What You Will Do:

  • Product Mastery: Independently study and master the specifications, benefits, and applications of our product line (informational guides provided).

  • Client Education: Instruct clients on the preparation of specific Yogurt cultures, DIY methods and the proper use of Parent Company products

  • Sales Generation: Use your expertise to generate sales through a personalized affiliate link or partner code.

  • Autonomy: Manage your own schedule and outreach strategy. No minimum quotas or required sales goals.



Ideal Candidate Profile: We are seeking individuals with a high level of intuition and specialized educational backgrounds. While not strictly required, we prioritize candidates with the following:

  • Holistic Background: Practicing Holistic Specialists or those deeply familiar with Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM).

  • Gifted Education: Individuals who have participated in formal GATE (Gifted and Talented Education), who are Medicinal Intuitive and who are familiar with ESP.

  • Independent Workers: You thrive when given a set of materials and left to develop your own instructional, communication and sales style.

  • Strong Communicators: You enjoy teaching others and can simplify complex wellness concepts.



Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive Commission: Earn between 8% and 20% on every sale generated.

  • Zero Start-up Costs: It is completely free to sign up and join our affiliate program.

  • Flexible Schedule: This is a 100% remote, independent contractor position. You when and where you want.

  • Training Materials: Comprehensive guides on yogurt making and product usage are provided to all qualifying partners.
